name: Sealskin
description: Sealskin is a self-hosted browser isolation and remote application streaming platform. It runs desktop applications in isolated containers on a server you control and streams them to any browser or phone. Clients include a browser extension, mobile apps, and a web app served by the server itself. Each turns links, files, downloads, and text selections into something you open remotely instead of locally, so nothing from the web runs on the device in front of you.
short_desc: Sealskin is a self-hosted browser isolation and remote application streaming platform
author: linuxserver.io
